summary: This Form 6-K filed by Nayax Ltd. (Nasdaq: NYAX) furnishes a press release and corporate presentation announcing first quarter 2026 financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026. Revenue reached $106.9 million, up 32% year-over-year, with net income of $1.3 million and Adjusted EBITDA of $13.9 million. The filing is a routine earnings release with no mention of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPAC activity, or management changes. No special-situation category applies.
